notes: Separate entry from Duromatic-Airco, encoded ONLY from this brand's own page, even though the two pages carry identical style text and the identical example serial. No cross-page import. Serial is all digits, so the page's 'numerical digits' are character positions. Page example decodes to March 1985.

styles.notes: Page positions 1st & 2nd = year, 3rd & 4th = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges [0,2] and [2,4].
